title: Equivariant learning of a transferable three-dimensional classical density functional
abstract: arXiv:2608.13506v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Liquids exhibit collective behavior that depends sensitively on thermodynamic conditions, interfaces and confinement, yet predicting each new state commonly requires a separate atomistic simulation. Classical density functional theory offers a reusable variational description, but its central excess free-energy functional is generally unknown, and learned approximations have largely remained restricted to planar or lower-dimensional settings. Here we show that this functional can be learned directly from fully three-dimensional equilibrium density fields while preserving spatial symmetry and variational consistency, without free-energy or chemical-potential labels. A single learned functional transfers across temperatures, system sizes and statistical ensembles, and recovers structure factors, the equation of state, liquid--vapor coexistence and interfacial broadening, none of which are used as training targets. translated_title: 可转移三维经典密度泛函的等变学习
translated_abstract: 液体表现出对热力学条件、界面和限域敏感的整体行为，但预测每一种新状态通常需要单独的原子模拟。经典密度泛函理论提供了一种可重复使用的变分描述，但其核心的过量自由能泛函通常是未知的，而学习近似大多局限于平面或低维设置。在这里，我们展示了该泛函可以直接从全三维平衡密度场中学习，同时保持空间对称性和变分一致性，无需自由能或化学势标签。一个学习到的泛函可跨温度、系统尺寸和统计系综转移，并恢复结构因子、状态方程、液-气共存和界面增宽，这些均未作为训练目标。应用于复杂三维系统时，该泛函表现出优异的泛化能力。
tldr: 本文提出一种等变学习方法，直接从三维密度场中学习经典密度泛函理论中的过量自由能泛函，无需标签即可跨条件转移并预测多种未训练的物理性质。
en_tdlr: This paper presents an equivariant learning approach to directly learn the excess free-energy functional in classical density functional theory from three-dimensional density fields, enabling label-free transfer across conditions and prediction of untrained physical properties.
